decisions.text: Marco Moretti (Youth) was shown a straight red against Wolfsburg and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 2 matches ban stood.
